description: Onboard a batch of NEW or CHANGED Ramco source files into the Brain — the end-to-end playbook that runs WHENEVER a `git pull` of `ramco-erp-brain/` lands new/changed files, a new folder/BPC/artefact-class appears, or the user says "sync the brain", "a git pull brought new data", "ingest the delta", "new files were added to the source, update the brain", or "the source changed — reflect it". This is the DELTA ORCHESTRATOR: it detects the change set, documents it, classifies every path, and routes each class through the `reindex-brain` skill (§A/§B/§C), then proves no regression with the `eval-brain` skill before anything becomes visible. It composes those two skills — it does not replace them. Governing rule (inherited): every change is a strictly additive, non-regressing positive delta; the current Brain is pre-eminent; nothing is deleted, no prior answer regresses.
